thread:
emma-finops: FYI got a budget alert this morning: daily GPU run-rate for project redwood-mlsvc spiked to $2.4k, above the weekly threshold. Anyone seeing jobs that would explain this?
raj-cloud: we pushed a staged CI matrix overnight that used longer GPU leases. should have been limited but looks like a concurrency bug.
oliver-ops: can you paste the alert rows? i'll correlate with autoscaler logs.
emma-finops: CSV extract:
```
project,resource,day,cost,cc_tag
redwood-mlsvc,gpu-train-11,2026-03-20,2400.00,ml-platform
redwood-mlsvc,gpu-train-12,2026-03-20,150.00,unknown
redwood-recs,gpu-hpo-3,2026-03-20,90.00,recs
```
raj-cloud: that `unknown` tag is odd; but the $2.4k line is the big one. the CI job id is ci-matrix-789. it kept hogging 4x longer than expected.
oliver-ops: killing the runaway job now. job-id ci-matrix-789 -> terminated.
billing-bot: Alert created: GPU budget threshold breach for redwood-mlsvc (run-rate $2.4k). Ticket FIN-812. https://billing.internal/tickets/FIN-812
emma-finops: we need a quick allocation plan: do we want to charge the owning team or absorb in platform budget? current policy says developer experiments >$1k should be charged back to team owner, but this was an automation test for platform.
cecilia-pm: product used the CI to validate a release candidate; PMs ok to absorb up to $1k but not beyond without approval.
raj-cloud: request exception: platform absorbed $1k, remaining $1.4k to be split between eng-sre and ml-platform 70/30 (engineering judgment).
emma-finops: propose workflow: 1) absorb $1k from org contingency; 2) allocate remaining $1.4k by 70/30 split; 3) tag the incident and notify owners.
cecilia-pm: approved the exception for $1k. please include note in the March run-rate report.
oliver-ops: added autoscaler guard: prevent >2 concurrent CI matrix GPUs per namespace. PR#4620.
billing-bot: FIN-812 updated: provisional allocation applied (contingency $1k, platform $980, eng-sre $420). Follow-up: reconcile after tag backfill.
emma-finops: i'll run allocation script and publish corrected run-rate in the weekly cost report. thanks all. :thumbsup:
